sql_templates.description: Rank sectors by breadth signal and Stage 2 participation within the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, 
           MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
), 
ranked_sectors AS (
    SELECT sd.sector, 
           sd.breadth_signal, 
           ma.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma
    ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    JOIN latest_stage ls
    ON sd.sector = ls.sector
    WHERE sd.snapshot_date = ls.max_snapshot_date
    AND sd.snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_sectors;

synthesis_guidance: Focus on highlighting sectors with significant Stage 2 migration and present them as ranked candidates.
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 1245
validation_rules: Ensure SQL is read-only and uses approved columns.
Align point-in-time data using join rules.
